tools.name: find_gpu
tools.description: Find cloud GPUs to rent now: price per GPU hour and the stock each provider reported at the last hourly check. Rentable offers come first, cheapest first. Each offer has a rent_url that opens the provider (some are referral links, same price for the buyer).

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_gpu" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Find cloud GPUs to rent now: price per GPU hour and the stock each provider reported at the last daily check. Rentable offers come first, cheapest first.
